answerError.empty: Type an answer first, or h for help.
answerError.commandInLine: “{{word}}” is a command; send it on its own.

error.window_too_short: The window cannot be shorter than {{minMs}} ms.

label.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo in this session.

help.labels: Type pattern keys or full ids, separated by spaces or commas, then Enter saves the window and moves on. Clicking a chip adds or removes its key.
help.noPattern: x answers “no clear pattern” and is stored, unlike a skip.
help.flags: m and ? toggle mixed and unsure, tl/tr mark the thumb side (the same side again clears it); alone or inside a label line.
help.commands: Alone on the line: s skip, u undo the last label, w+/w- widen or narrow by 1 s, n/p shift by half a window, q end the session.
help.hotkeys: Typing anywhere goes into the answer box. Space plays or pauses while the box is empty, Enter saves, Esc clears it. F3 and F4 lower or raise the osu! speed.
